card.name: Negation before adverse events after dosing
card.fires_on: The words "without", "no" or "absence of" right after a dose, infusion or overdose is described, just before adverse reactions, toxicity or events are named.

modes.label: Without after doses given
modes.description: "without" follows a description of doses or infusions received and leads into reactions or toxicity.
modes.example: For patients who have received 12 infusions<< without>> evidence of a hypersensitivity reaction, observe

modes.label: No after with or if
modes.description: "no" follows "with" or "If" and leads into adverse events or sequelae.
modes.example: took an accidental overdose of ezetimibe 120 mg/day for 28 days with<< no>> reported clinical or laboratory adverse events.

card.writes: It favors words like incident and accidents, and disfavors words about possible or potential outcomes.
card.plain: It marks the spot where text says doses were given with no bad events following.
